messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "children between 12 and 18 years of age with risk factors for breathing problems"
set: ["children between 12 and 18 years of age with risk factors for breathing problems", "risk factors for breathing problems", "rhinitis (adults and children 12 years of age and older)", "individuals younger than 18 years old with breathing problems", "children 6 years of age and older", "children 2 years of age and older", "rarely occurs in children under 12 years of age", "younger than 12 years of age", "increased risk of breathing problems", "children from birth to less than 18 years of age", "children under 6 years of age for narcolepsy", "children under 3 years of age for ADHD", "children under 15 years of age", "people with other risk factors", "children younger than 8 years of age with HeFH", "children younger than 7 years of age with HoFH"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
